meta.title: Jamie Hart — Marina Operations & Safety Expert Witness
meta.description: Jamie Hart, C.M.M.: marina operations and safety expert witness. Supervisor of Marine Facilities for the City of Fort Lauderdale, 1985 to 2010; Hart Marine Consulting, Tavares, Florida.

items.k: Years running Fort Lauderdale’s marine facilities, 1985 to 2010
In grant funding secured for marina and waterway projects, per his CV

items.t: Supervisor of Marine Facilities for the City of Fort Lauderdale for 25 years, then Marina Harbor Director for the Town of Lake Park.
items.d: Operations, staffing, maintenance, safety, code enforcement and revenue, at municipal marinas of 112 and 190 slips.

items.t: Independent expert and consultant, Hart Marine Consulting, Inc., Tavares, Florida.
items.d: Standard of care, liability exposure and causation in marina injury, wrongful death and design cases, nationwide.

items.t: Retained by plaintiff and defense counsel, including Fowler White Burnett and Wilson Elser.
items.d: Case analysis, site inspections, deposition review, expert reports and testimony.

sections.lead: On Jamie Hart, from the late Robert O. Cox, former Fort Lauderdale City Commissioner and Mayor:
